europe_now.title: Rescue efforts continue after ferry capsizes off northern Cyprus
europe_now.summary: A ferry carrying more than 250 passengers capsized off the coast of northern Cyprus, resulting in at least eight deaths and dozens missing. Rescue operations are ongoing, with emergency services searching for survivors.

sources.headline: Eight killed and 18 missing after ferry capsizes off northern Cyprus

europe_now.title: Iceland's electorate votes down resumption of EU accession talks
europe_now.summary: Iceland's electorate has voted against resuming negotiations on joining the European Union, according to official results. The parliament is set to discuss the implications of the vote in upcoming sessions.

top_stories.summary: Norway's newly crowned monarch has delivered an address to the nation following the death of his predecessor. The transition marks a significant moment in the country's royal history.

top_stories.title: NATO's increased Arctic activity draws Russian criticism
top_stories.summary: NATO's increased operational activity in the Arctic has been characterised by Russia’s foreign minister as a direct threat to its security. The remarks follow the alliance’s expansion of exercises and presence in the region.

sources.headline: NATO's Arctic activity poses 'direct threat' to Russia, Lavrov warns

top_stories.title: Observers warn Germany faces a pivotal political juncture
top_stories.summary: Analysts suggest that Germany is entering one of its most challenging political periods in recent years, citing the rise of extremist movements and internal divisions. The assessment comes amid ongoing debates about the country's policy direction.

sources.headline: Germany is poised to enter one of its most dangerous moments yet
